Some practical exposure to Operational Technology (OT), industrial, or manufacturing systems . Good understanding of cybersecurity principles and security-awareness best practices . Proven ability to work independently while remaining aligned with global standards and policies. Strong customer-service orientation and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
